decks.notes: This deck focuses on using strong creatures and spells to control the game and dismantle the opponent's strategies. It utilizes efficient removal and disruption spells like Smother, Duress, and Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Spiritmonger, Ravenous Baloth, and Blastoderm to pressure the opponent and control the battlefield. With access to cards like Pernicious Deed and Recurring Nightmare, this deck can maintain board control and outvalue the opponent over time. It aims to grind out the game and emerge victorious through resource management and strategic decision-making.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption spells like Duress and Bottomless Pit, as well as creature removal like Smother and Snuff Out. The deck also aims to apply pressure with efficient creatures like Nantuko Shade and Dauthi creatures, while utilizing The Rack as a win condition. With a mix of discard, removal, and threats, the deck aims to outvalue and outpace the opponent in a 1 vs 1 premodern format.

This Elves deck focuses on ramping up mana with creatures like Fyndhorn Elves and Priest of Titania, while also generating card advantage with cards like Deranged Hermit and Wirewood Symbiote. Survival of the Fittest helps to tutor for key creatures, while Tangle Wire disrupts the opponent's board. The deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with its mana production and efficient creatures, finishing off the game with powerful beaters like Kamahl, Fist of Krosa and Masticore. It aims to win the game quickly through aggressive creature plays and efficient resource management.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble multiple enchantresses on the battlefield to draw cards whenever you play an enchantment. The deck also focuses on using enchantments like Sterling Grove and Replenish to create a powerful engine that generates card advantage and allows you to control the board with cards like Humility and Karmic Justice. Finally, the deck aims to win through a combination of locking down the opponent with enchantments like Parallax Wave and Sacred Mesa, and eventually overwhelming them with powerful enchantment creatures like Opalescence.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by countering spells, removing threats, and delaying the opponent's strategy. It uses a combination of counterspells, removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Earthquake, as well as card draw with Accumulated Knowledge to maintain card advantage. The deck also has some land manipulation with Portent and Chance Encounter to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to control the game until it can either win through traditional beats or with the combo of Chance Encounter and Frenetic Efreet.

The focus of this deck is on disrupting and controlling the opponent's board through removal and mass land destruction while also deploying resilient threats in the form of powerful angels and creatures with additional utility. It aims to establish a dominant position through efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Wrath of God, while also generating card advantage and additional threats with Decree of Justice. The inclusion of mana acceleration in the form of Lotus Petal and Tooth of Ramos allows for faster deployment of threats like Exalted Angel and Masticore to overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on controlling the board with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Oath of Druids, while also utilizing cards like Scroll Rack and Land Tax to dig through the deck for key pieces. The key strategy revolves around setting up the Oath of Druids combo to cheat out powerful creatures like Triskelion and Phantom Nishoba, while also disrupting the opponent?s game plan with effects like Armageddon and Seal of Cleansing. The deck also uses life gain and card advantage to outlast opponents and grind out victories.

This deck focuses on aggressively playing efficient creatures like Rogue Elephant, River Boa, and Mtenda Lion, supported by mana acceleration from Llanowar Elves and Land Grant. It aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of creature buffs like Rancor and Elephant Guide, combat tricks like Giant Growth and Bounty of the Hunt, and disruption with Winter Orb. The deck's goal is to establish a fast, resilient board presence and apply pressure to the opponent early in the game.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly with elves and Gaea's Cradle, while utilizing Survival of the Fittest to tutor for key creatures like Deranged Hermit and Kamahl, Fist of Krosa. These creatures, along with other elves, create a fast and aggressive board presence, with the potential for explosive plays. The inclusion of Squee, Goblin Nabob and Anger provide additional recursion and haste to keep the pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of elves and powerful threats, ending the game quickly.

This deck aims to control the game by countering opponent's spells and disrupting their hand with cards like Duress and Meddling Mage. It also grows its own creatures with cards like Quirion Dryad and Psychatog, using spells like Gush and Fire/Ice to fuel their abilities. The deck is designed to be efficient and quick, using cards like Daze and Portent to keep the opponent off balance. The deck's mana base is designed to allow for flexibility and consistency in casting spells.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's plays through cards like Swords to Plowshares and Meddling Mage, while also providing strategic solutions with Seal of Cleansing and Future Sight. It utilizes a combination of white and blue spells and creatures to maintain dominance on the battlefield, with Exalted Angel and Lightning Angel as win conditions. The mana base is designed to provide ample color fixing and ramp, ensuring consistency in casting spells and maintaining control over the game.

This deck focuses on using control spells and creatures that grow in power as the game progresses. By disrupting the opponent and steadily building up card advantage through draw spells, the deck aims to establish board presence with creatures like Lord of Atlantis, Quirion Dryad, and Gaea's Skyfolk. Winter Orb is used to slow down the opponent's mana development while cards like Daze and Foil provide additional disruption. The deck's strategy is to outpace and outlast the opponent through careful resource management and strategic play.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through spells like Lightning Bolt, Incinerate, and Pyrostatic Pillar while also utilizing Oath of Druids as a win condition. The main strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with removal spells and damage while ramping up to play Oath of Druids to put powerful creatures into play. The deck also includes cards like Sulfuric Vortex and Bloodfire Colossus to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. It aims to establish board control and finish the game with big creatures or burn spells.

The main focus of this deck is to establish a lock on the game using Stasis in combination with Forsaken City to prevent opponents from untapping their permanents. This creates a stall in the game while drawing cards with Howling Mine and dealing damage with Black Vise. The deck also includes counterspells like Foil, Daze, and Arcane Denial to protect the combo. Overall, the deck aims to control the game state and disrupt opponents' strategies until it can secure a win condition.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the necessary combo pieces to win the game. Using cards like Tinker to search for key artifacts like Phyrexian Devourer and Altar of Dementia, the deck aims to mill the opponent's library for a one-shot kill with Fling. Defense Grid and Tangle Wire help protect the combo from disruption, while cards like Intuition and Impulse help dig for the necessary pieces. With efficient mana acceleration from cards like Lotus Petal and Mind Stone, the deck aims to win the game before the opponent can mount a defense.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and board wipes. The deck aims to maintain control of the battlefield by using cards like Swords to Plowshares and Wrath of God to deal with threats, while also utilizing cards like Fact or Fiction and Cunning Wish to provide card advantage. The inclusion of Parallax Tide and Decree of Justice allows for additional board control options, while Nevinyrral's Disk acts as a potential reset button. The land base is optimized for consistent mana production and utility.
